name: @workflow/ai-end-reason
description: Single source of truth for the AI node `output.result.endReason` value domain (AI Agent / Information Extractor), shared between the backend handlers that produce it and the frontend conversation UI that gates on it.

scripts.prepare: node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process');let ts=true;try{require.resolve('typescript/package.json')}catch{ts=false};if(ts){c.execSync('tsc',{stdio:'inherit'})}else if(!f.existsSync('dist')){throw new Error('prepare: typescript is unavailable and dist/ is missing — cannot produce the build output')}"
